# Minima Vue - Full LLM Context

This file replaces the prior Medusa-specific corpus with Minima Vue repository context.

## 1) Project Overview

- Repository: `minima-vue3`
- Type: npm workspaces monorepo
- Workspaces: `icons`, `toolbox`, `ui-preset`, `ui`, `docs`, `dashboard`
- Documentation brand: Minima Vue
- Primary goal: Vue-first component system for admin extensions and standalone apps.

## 2) Root Scripts

- `dev`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `dev:docs`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `dev:dashboard`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/dashboard`
- `generate:docs`: `npm run generate --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `changeset`: `changeset`
- `version-packages`: `changeset version`
- `release`: `changeset publish`
- `build:packages`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `pack:packages`: `npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `publish:packages`: `npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `build:docs`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `build:dashboard`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/dashboard`
- `build`: `npm run build:packages && npm run build:docs && npm run build:dashboard`

## 3) Workspace Package Metadata

### @minima-vue/ui
- Path: `ui`
- Version: `1.0.6`
- Description: Minima Vue components for Vue 3
- Peer dependencies: `@minima-vue/icons`, `@minima-vue/ui-preset`, `vue`
- Key scripts:
- `dev`: `vite`
- `build`: `vue-tsc && vite build`
- `preview`: `vite preview`
- `storybook`: `storybook dev -p 6006`
- `build-storybook`: `storybook build`
- `prepack`: `npm run build`

### @minima-vue/icons
- Path: `icons`
- Version: `1.0.6`
- Description: Minima Vue icon library
- Peer dependencies: `vue`
- Key scripts:
- `build`: `tsup && npm run build:types`
- `build:types`: `vue-tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist`
- `dev`: `tsup --watch`
- `generate`: `toolbox icons -o './src/components'`
- `prepack`: `npm run build`

### @minima-vue/ui-preset
- Path: `ui-preset`
- Version: `1.0.6`
- Description: Minima Vue UI preset
- Peer dependencies: `tailwindcss`
- Key scripts:
- `build`: `tsup`
- `generate`: `toolbox tokens -o './src/theme'`
- `dev`: `tsup --watch`
- `prepack`: `npm run build`

### @minima-vue/toolbox
- Path: `toolbox`
- Version: `1.0.6`
- Description: CLI tool for importing Figma designs for Minima Vue
- Key scripts:
- `build`: `tsup`
- `prepack`: `npm run build`

### @minima-vue/docs
- Path: `docs`
- Version: `1.0.0`
- Key scripts:
- `generate`: `node ./scripts/generate-docs.mjs`
- `dev`: `npm run generate && vite`
- `build`: `npm run generate && vite build`
- `preview`: `vite preview`

### @minima-vue/dashboard
- Path: `dashboard`
- Version: `1.0.0`
- Key scripts:
- `dev`: `vite`
- `build`: `vue-tsc && vite build`
- `preview`: `vite preview`

## 4) Installation Guidance (Authoritative Snippets)

### Standalone Project
- Install runtime packages:
  - `npm install @minima-vue/ui @minima-vue/icons`
- Install preset:
  - `npm install -D @minima-vue/ui-preset`
- Import styles in app entry:
  - `import "@minima-vue/ui/style.css"`
- Tailwind v3 essentials:
  - Add preset: `presets: [preset]`
  - Include UI dist in content scanning.
- Tailwind v4 essentials:
  - `@source "../node_modules/@minima-vue/ui";`
  - `@config "@minima-vue/ui-preset";`

### Admin Extension
- Use `@minima-vue/ui` and `@minima-vue/icons` directly in admin extension packages.
- Use `@minima-vue/toolbox` for token/icon generation where needed.

## 5) Docs Navigation Model

- Introduction: `/`
- Installation:
  - `/installation/medusa-admin-extension`
  - `/installation/standalone-project`
- Icons: `/icons/overview`
- Colors: `/colors/overview`
- Components: `/components/<slug>`
- Hooks:
  - `/hooks/use-prompt`
  - `/hooks/use-toggle-state`
- Utils:
  - `/utils/clx`

## 6) UI Public Surface Summary

- Components documented: 42
- Reference exports (components + subcomponents): 131
- Composables:
  - `useToggleState(initial?: boolean)`
  - `usePrompt()` (currently throws "not yet implemented")
  - `useToast()` and `toast` helper (info/success/warning/error/loading)
- Utils:
  - `clx`
  - `calendar`
  - `isBrowserLocaleHourCycle24h`
  - `isInputElement`

### Alert (slug: `alert`)
- Description: A component for working with alert values in Minima Vue.
- Main export: `Alert`
- Has stories: yes
- Examples: `alert-demo`, `alert-success`, `alert-warning`, `alert-error`, `alert-dismissable`
- Usage snippets:
```ts

```

```tsx

```
- Export details:
- Export `Alert` from `Alert.vue` (main)
- Props:
  - `variant` (optional) type: `"info" | "error" | "success" | "warning"`, default: `"info"`
  - `dismissible` (optional) type: `boolean`, default: `false`
